intro: Gather, share, and connect around the Brawn dining table. Its tempered glass top and spacious design bring simplicity and style to mealtime, making every gathering feel effortlessly special​.

features.title: Durable glass top
features.text: Crafted with a thick tempered glass top, it offers long-lasting durability, perfect for family meals and gatherings.

features.title: Room for everyone
features.text: Make room for everyone. Designed as a six-seater, this table offers plenty of space—perfect for family meals and hosting guests with ease.

features.title: Practical built-in shelf
features.text: Keep essentials close at hand—a built-in shelf makes storing tableware and decor effortless, keeping your dining area tidy.

features.title: Contemporary design
features.text: Bold yet versatile—the table’s clean lines and sleek design elevate your modern home without overwhelming it.

features.title: Perfect blend of style and utility
features.text: Your dining table should do more—this one blends functionality with style, becoming the perfect centrepiece for gatherings and everyday meals.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
